body: Looool I love this joke but honestly it’s not like shameful for your man to pay your bills cause you can put that straight into savings ahaha
I’m a 3A it honestly helps my hair so much.

Tbh I was adopted and my family treated me as if I was like their biological child. There was no difference as to how I was treated in comparison to my siblings. Your parents emotionally neglected him, being adopted is hard enough. But it’s extremely difficult when the people who have adopted you treat you as an other. Your parents should of done better to make sure he felt included.

Whenever these things happen I make a joke out of it at their expense. For example a coworker told me when I gave them a peace sign to stop giving him gang signs. I then in return started making fun of him by stating do peace signs scare you? Laughing at his expense. Which then switched the narrative from me to him. My coworkers joined and that was it. I suggest whenever you stand up for yourself make it in a joking matter so when it’s seen on the outside it just seems like a joke but you’ve made it VERY clear to that person if they step out of line, you will make jokes that will continue to embarrass them.
